entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You gotta hear us out, Morgana!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's nothing I have to talk to you[n]about.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Come on. There's no need to keep[n]being so stubborn.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I can't just give in like this! I have my pride[n]to protect!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems we've fallen for the oldest trick[n]in the book...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It'll never end at this rate... What do we[n]do now?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't hear the sound of his engine at all...[n]Could they have left Mementos?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Our lack of vehicle puts us at a severe[n]disadvantage... We should probably just[n]head home for today.
